mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlement ( owner_id, settlement_type, settlement_status, settlement_category, title, split_type, total_amount, due_date, created_at ) VALUES ( #{ownerId}, #{settlementType}, #{settlementStatus}, #{settlementCategory}, #{title}, #{splitType}, #{totalAmount}, #{dueDate}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT settlement_id, owner_id, settlement_type, settlement_status, settlement_category, title, split_type, total_amount, due_date, cycle_rule, start_date, end_date, created_at, closed_at, status, cycle_date, invitation_token FROM settlement WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId}

SELECT settlement_id, owner_id, settlement_type, settlement_status, settlement_category, title, split_type, total_amount, due_date, cycle_rule, start_date, end_date, created_at, closed_at, status, cycle_date, invitation_token FROM settlement WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.settlement_id AS settlementId, s.title AS title, CASE WHEN s.owner_id = #{userId} THEN 'OWNER' ELSE 'MEMBER' END AS role, s.settlement_category AS settlementCategory, s.settlement_type AS settlementType, s.split_type AS splitType, s.settlement_status AS settlementStatus, s.due_date AS dueDate FROM settlement s WHERE s.owner_id = #{userId}
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM settlement_participant sp JOIN settlement_invitation si ON si.invitation_id = sp.invitation_id
WHERE si.settlement_id = s.settlement_id AND si.user_id = #{userId} AND si.invitation_status = 'ACCEPTED' AND sp.participant_status = 'ACTIVE' )
ORDER BY s.settlement_id DESC

SELECT s.settlement_id AS settlementId, s.title AS title, s.settlement_category AS settlementCategory, s.settlement_type AS settlementType, s.settlement_status AS settlementStatus, s.split_type AS splitType, s.due_date AS dueDate, s.created_at AS createdAt,
CASE WHEN s.owner_id = #{userId} THEN 'OWNER'
WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM settlement_invitation si JOIN settlement_participant sp ON sp.invitation_id = si.invitation_id
WHERE si.settlement_id = s.settlement_id AND si.user_id = #{userId} AND si.invitation_status = 'ACCEPTED' AND sp.participant_status = 'ACTIVE' ) THEN 'MEMBER'
ELSE 'NONE' END AS role
FROM settlement s WHERE s.settlement_id = #{settlementId}
